messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: Release v2026.07.14 -> prod PAUSED by preflight: env parity mismatch for key `DB_URL`. staging and prod formats differ (encoded vs plain). See preflight: https://ci.internal/runs/12133

yana: Can someone paste the two values?

ci-bot: preflight snippet:
```
staging: DB_URL=ENC[AES256_GCM,data:...,iv:...]
prod: DB_URL=postgres://svc:••••@db.prod:5432/app?sslmode=require
```

marco: We migrated some tenant secrets to SOPS envelopes in staging last week. Prod still uses a resolved DSN. The connector treats anything starting with "ENC[" as an opaque blob and skips resolution.

yana: Canary showed connection failures on startup when the service received the SOPS envelope. Crash loops for a subset of pods.

ops-oncall: Change window closes in 2 hours. Any prod change requires infra lead sign-off.

marco: Options: 1) rollback to v2026.07.13 (fast) 2) add an init step that decrypts SOPS envelope for canary and sets DB_URL_RESOLVED env 3) re-run secret migration to replace envelope with resolved DSN in prod (long).

yana: Hotpatch init decrypt feels lowest blast radius and lets us continue other fixes. I can build a small init that calls internal sops-agent and writes DB_URL_RESOLVED, no secrets in logs.

sec-bot: Security constraints: init image must be internal, run with minimal privileges, and produce an audit entry for decryption. No plaintext in logs.

marco: I'll create a compatibility alias in paramstore named DB_URL_PLAIN and backfill the DSN for the canary clusters, emitting audit events. ETA ~20m.

ci-bot: Reminder: a few CI tests assert exact DB_URL text. Update CI to prefer DB_URL_PLAIN when present, else DB_URL.

yana: Spinning up 5% canary with init-decrypt that writes DB_URL_RESOLVED -> app reads that. Running 15m smoke.

marco: Alias DB_URL_PLAIN created and audit logged: https://audit.internal/entry/12133-db-url-backfill

yana: Canary 10m smoke: no connection errors, metrics stable. No secret exposure. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Infra eyeballs OK. Approve limited rollout. Keep rollback ready if anything spikes.

marco: I'll open follow-up ticket INF-2041 to standardize secret encoding across envs and remove DB_URL_PLAIN after migration.

yana: Drafting release note: "Release paused due to DB_URL encoding parity; temporary decrypt-init + DB_URL_PLAIN alias used for controlled rollout; follow-up: standardize secret backend and remove compatibility alias." Confluence: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.07.14-db-url-encoding-note

deploy-bot: Release v2026.07.14 status: PAUSED -> CANARY (init-decrypt) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assigned: marco (alias/backfill + ticket), yana (init canary + notes), ops-oncall (monitor). Action log recorded."
